suzuki.abstract: <jats:p>A general scheme of fractal decomposition of exponential operators is presented in any order m. Namely, exp[x(A+B)]=Sm(x)+O(xm+1) for any positive integer m, where Sm(x)=et1A et2B et3A et4B⋅⋅⋅etMA with finite M depending on m. A general recursive scheme of construction of {tj} is given explicitly. It is proven that some of {tj} should be negative for m≥3 and for any finite M (nonexistence theorem of positive decomposition). General systematic decomposition criterions based on a new type of time-ordering are also formulated. The decomposition exp[x(A+B)]=[Sm(x/n)]n +O(xm+1/nm) yields a new efficient approach to quantum Monte Carlo simulations.</jats:p>
title: General theory of fractal path integrals with applications to many-body theories and statistical physics
